title: feat(mail): JMAP multi-user: resolve user_id from canonical_account_id
description:
mail/src/server.rs:435 has a live TODO: resolve user_id from canonical_account_id. Email/get currently does not fully resolve per-user identity from the JMAP accountId, which means multi-user JMAP deployments cannot correctly scope mailbox access.

Why this exists: the JMAP server was built out with single-user assumptions; multi-user plumbing is partially stubbed.

What needs to be done:
1. Audit all JMAP method handlers (Email/get, Email/query, Mailbox/get, Thread/get) for places where user_id is assumed or skipped.
2. Implement canonical_account_id → user_id resolution: define the mapping (OIDC sub, DID, local account) and wire it through the session context.
3. Enforce per-account mailbox scoping: each JMAP accountId must only see its own mailboxes and email.
4. Add integration tests for at least two distinct accounts to verify isolation.
